draft.emotion: attentive and quiet, catching a sound in the distance
notes: Belongs to the second conjugation despite ending in -ать (я слышу, ты слышишь, они слышат).
Слышать means to perceive sound with your ears ('to hear'), whereas слушать means to pay attention to sound ('to listen').
